heroSummary: Newport News Public Schools begins classes on Monday, August 24, 2026, and the last student day is Tuesday, June 8, 2027. The approved calendar includes 178 student days and more than 990 instructional hours. Students return on January 5, 2027, after Winter Break. After Spring Break, classes resume on April 13, 2027, because April 12 is a teacher planning day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for NNPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day is Monday, August 24, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last student day for NNPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved calendar lists Tuesday, June 8, 2027, as the last student day, although make-up days could change the schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a teacher planning day when students do not attend, and schools reopen Tuesday, January 5. The second semester begins January 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 5–9, 2027. Students do not attend on the teacher planning day Monday, April 12, and return Tuesday, April 13.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the NNPS 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved calendar contains 178 student days and more than 990 instructional hours. Virginia permits school divisions to meet the requirement through 180 days or 990 instructional hours.

calendarFaqs.q: Which NNPS dates affect high school students?
calendarFaqs.a: High schools have half-day exam schedules January 20–22 and early dismissal and exam dates June 4, 7, and 8. Tentative graduation ceremonies are listed for June 3–4.

calendarFaqs.q: Are the 2027 NNPS graduation dates final?
calendarFaqs.a: No. NNPS labels June 3–4, 2027, as tentative high school graduation dates. Families of graduating seniors should confirm final times and locations with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for NNPS calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official NNPS calendars page and announcements from your child’s school before making plans. The ICS file on this page is a one-time import and does not update automatically.

customSections.label: What Families Should Know
customSections.content: A few teacher workdays extend the time students are out of school beyond the dates officially labeled as a break.

groups.label: Winter Break and the second semester are separate milestones
items: Winter Break ends January 1, but January 4 is a teacher planning day and students return January 5.
The second semester begins January 27 after high school exams and two additional no-school days.

groups.label: Thanksgiving creates a three-day no-school period
items: NNPS labels Thursday and Friday, November 26–27, as the Thanksgiving Observance.

groups.label: Spring Break is followed by a teacher planning day
items: Students do not attend Monday, April 12, and return Tuesday, April 13.

groups.label: Half-day and early-dismissal schedules affect several dates
items: High schools follow half-day exam schedules January 20–22.
All schools have half-day dismissal May 28, while June 4, 7, and 8 are early-dismissal and exam dates.

customSections.label: High School Exams and Graduation
customSections.content: For high school families: exams use half-day schedules January 20–22 and early-dismissal schedules June 4, 7, and 8. NNPS lists June 3–4 graduation dates as tentative, so families should confirm ceremony times and locations with their school.

customSections.label: Staff and District Office Dates
customSections.content: These dates appear on the approved NNPS calendar but fall outside the main student attendance list.

groups.label: Staff reporting dates
items: All teachers and teacher assistants report August 13, 2026.
The last teacher day is June 9, 2027.

groups.label: Office schedule dates
items: Independence Day is observed July 3, 2026, and Juneteenth is observed June 18, 2027.
NNPS schools and offices are closed on designated Fridays during summer operations.

comparisonTitle: NNPS Calendar Compared With Hampton Roads Districts
comparisonSummary: NNPS, Hampton City Schools, Virginia Beach City Public Schools, and York County School Division all begin classes on August 24, 2026. Their spring-break and last-day schedules differ.

comparisonInsights.label: Opening day
items: All four Hampton Roads divisions begin classes on Monday, August 24.

comparisonInsights.label: Spring break
items: NNPS, Hampton, and York schedule Spring Break for April 5–9.
Virginia Beach schedules Spring Break one week earlier, March 29–April 2.

comparisonInsights.label: Scheduled last day
items: NNPS ends June 8, Hampton and York end June 9, and Virginia Beach ends June 11.

comparisonSourceNote: The table compares published districtwide dates. Emergency closures or later revisions may change the final student day.
